plan.title: v0.78 update leaves migrated xbrief schema and version derivative stale

narratives.Description: v0.78 update leaves migrated xbrief schema and version derivative stale
narratives.Overview:
Consumer upgrade from v0.72 to v0.78 reproduced two post-migration drifts: (1) xbrief/.deft-version remains 0.72.0 even after directive update reports current 0.78.0; (2) xbrief/schemas/vbrief-core.schema.json retains the vBRIEFInfo v0.6 root schema after migrate:xbrief, and a subsequent directive update no-ops instead of refreshing it. directive doctor --full reports manifest-agreement failure and stale-xbrief-schema-deposit. Also, a cache-only xbrief/.triage-cache directory caused the first migrate:xbrief --force invocation to report converged without migrating project artifacts. Refs #2034/#2110/#2149.

### Comment by @dbcall2 (2026-07-16T00:04:19Z)

Additional v0.78.0 deposit defect: .deft/core/Taskfile.yml contains trailing whitespace on generated ENGINE_CMD lines 364 and 463, causing git diff --check to fail in consumer pre-PR validation.

items.title: Current update repairs xBRIEF schema and version derivatives

narrative.Acceptance: Given a current 0.78 core payload and manifest with a stale xbrief/.deft-version plus vbrief-core.schema.json, when directive update runs, then the payload copy and manifest rewrite remain no-ops while the marker becomes 0.78, the obsolete schema is removed, the current schema is present, doctor clears both reported drifts, and a second run performs no projection writes.

items.title: Greenfield schema projection excludes the obsolete v0.6 root

narrative.Acceptance: Given the framework schema deposit contains both legacy and current roots, when consumer xBRIEF scaffolding runs, then it projects current framework schemas, omits vbrief-core.schema.json, preserves unrelated consumer schemas, and rejects unsafe projection paths.

items.title: Cache-only canonical state does not suppress legacy migration

narrative.Acceptance: Given legacy vbrief project artifacts and an xbrief tree containing only .triage-cache plus placeholders, when migrate:xbrief --force runs, then project artifacts migrate, both input trees are backed up, unique cache records survive, canonical cache records win collisions, and a rerun is idempotent; unknown canonical files still prevent destructive migration.

items.title: Published Taskfile is free of trailing whitespace

narrative.Acceptance: Given the repository Taskfile and content-package prepack, when packaging and git diff checks run, then neither the source nor packaged Taskfile contains trailing spaces and CHANGELOG [Unreleased] records the repair.
